'''Klarymére''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[S'kytri]] and [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Highland Clans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. Serving as the people's [[Patriarch (Skye)|Patriarch]] at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he resided in the planet's capital city, the [[City of the Winged People]].

==Biography==
A green-pigmented [[S'kytri]] of the [[Highland Clans]], Klarymére served as the Patriarch of the planet [[Skye/Legends|Skye]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. He had a daughter named [[Kharys]], who was to succeed him as Matriarch of the S'kytri. At this time, the crazed [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] mutant, [[Zeta Magnus]] had brought a pathogen to Skye and unleashed it on her people, declaring himself [[Magister]] in the process. Sending a transmission to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Klarymére requested [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] assistance in eliminating Magnus in exchange for the S'kytri people's unending fealty to the Order. When three escape pods arrived on the planet, the Patriarch traveled to the rendezvous point and met with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his two [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Halagad Ventor]], hoping that they had brought supplies and an antidote to the pathogen. While those things were destroyed in the destruction of their ship in orbit, the Jedi and their four [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] assured Klarymére that they would do all they could to bring the Magister to justice. Escorting the offworlders to the gates of the [[City of the Winged People]] high in the summits of a nearby mountain, Klarymére brought the Jedi before the [[Supreme Council of the Highland Clans]] to discuss the future of the Tyrant which ruled over them. When the Jedi successfully convinced the Council to honor Klarymére's promise, the Patriarch's daughter suggested that the group infiltrate [[Kharys' fortress|Magnus' citadel]] atop [[Canaitith Mountain]] by traversing the legendary underworld of [[Entyrmion]]. When Kharys agreed to lead them, the Patriarch warned the Council that they should prepare an assault on the citadel and attack on their signal.<ref name="swcw" />

Entering into the fabled caverns of the Entyrmion, Klarymére traveled with his daughter, the Jedi and clones through the chilly cave system, cautious of encountering the legendary beasts said to have been sealed beneath the earth by the mythical [[Hormaket]] the Vanquisher. When the group entered into a sweltering chamber, they encountered dozens of Magnus' mutant [[Oskan blood eater]]s. As the Oskans swarmed around them, the Jedi and the S'kytri drew their blades while the clones fought with blasters. When his daughter Kharys was outnumbered, Klarymére flew to assist her but was skewered by a towering Oskan from behind. Collapsing to the floor, Klarymére bled out in a puddle of his own blood. While Skywalker killed the beast that struck down the Patriarch and the room was eventually cleared, the Jedi stood by as Kharys mourned her dying father. After swearing the Jedi to the task of killing Magnus, he told Kharys she would make a great Matriarch before expiring. Overwhelmed with grief, Kharys gave into the dark side and butchered the corpse of the Oskan which had slew her father before storming of with his body into the sky through a passage which had opened in the roof during the fighting. From there, Kharys delivered her father's body to the summits of [[Mount Krisklar]] so that [[skingle]]s could devour his heart, eyes, and liver as was custom.<ref name="swcw" />
